quotations.old_english: Nú is ófost betost, ðæt we þeódcyning ðǽr sceáwian
quotations.english: now is speed best, that we may see there the great king

source_text: betost; adj. Best; optimus :-- Nú is ófost betost, ðæt we þeódcyning ðǽr sceáwian now is speed best, that we may see there the great king, Beo. Th. 6007; B. 3007. v. betst.
